title: Whatever It Takes
author: Jesse A.
desc: The purpose of this program is to maximize hypertrophy while managing fatigue and protecting the lower back. It uses strict, controlled movements, lengthened-range loading, and RPE-guided intensity to ensure optimal muscle stimulus, balanced volume, and efficient recovery.
